desc.yi-sang: The manager of Limbus Company, possessing sharp intellect and a fractured self.
desc.faust: A brilliant practitioner of medicine with an insatiable thirst for truth.
desc.don-quixote: A passionate knight who fights for justice and ideals like no other.
desc.ryoshu: A calm and taciturn swordswoman who finds beauty in suffering.
desc.meursault: A stranger indifferent to the world, yet wielding overwhelming destructive power.
desc.hong-lu: An elegant young noble with a lavish background and leisurely demeanor.
desc.heathcliff: A rough and ruthless man harboring a dark past and obsessive vengeance.
desc.ishmael: A sailor who wandered the seas, possessing strong will and survival instincts.
desc.rodion: A sharp-minded individual living with guilt and inner conflict.
desc.sinclair: A pure yet conflicted youth wandering in search of his true self.
desc.outis: A mysterious figure acting in concealment, with exceptional strategic thinking.
desc.gregor: A silent being who underwent a grotesque transformation, yet retains something human.

meta.title: Identity meta analysis
meta.description: Public formations from the deck board and Mirror Dungeon planner
meta.emptyPeriod: No formations were published in this period.
meta.sample: {count} valid formations · {decks} decks · {planner} plans · {excluded} empty formations excluded
meta.methodology: Each public post has equal weight. Identities, EGO and keywords count once per formation. Keywords and co-occurrence use battle identities only. These are adoption frequencies, not strength or win rates.
meta.smallSample: Fewer than 20 samples. Individual posts can strongly affect the results.

analysis.companionsHint: Based on {count} formations deploying this identity in battle. Backup slots are excluded. Multiple identities can appear together, so percentages may total over 100%.
analysis.noCompanions: No other identities were deployed alongside this identity.
analysis.method: Based on {count} public posts using this identity in battle. EGO rates count equipment on the same Sinner.
analysis.purposeHint: Uses main keywords selected by authors. Multiple keywords are counted separately, so percentages may exceed 100%.
analysis.decks: Decks and plans using this identity
analysis.baseOnly: No non-base EGO records. Turn off the switch to include base EGOs.

experience.title: EXP calculator
experience.subtitle: Use your tickets wisely. Farm only what you need.
experience.inventoryHelp: Enter your stock of regular training tickets I–IV.
experience.planHelp: Combines your owned tickets with rewards from the selected farming method.
experience.noFarm: Your tickets already cover the target level.
experience.already: You have already reached the target level.
experience.excessHelp: Minimizes excess EXP first, then ticket count. Below the level cap, excess carries into the next level.
experience.skipHelp: Skipping costs 2× modules and gives 1.5× each ticket quantity, rounded up. 20 Enkephalin = 1 module.
